deploybot: Deploy initiated: canary -> prod | tag: v2.14.1 | commit: 9f3b2d1. CI Gate running checks: unit, smoke-e2e, security-scan.

joanna: @sam can you grab the smoke-e2e log and quick triage? :eyes:
sam: on it. smoke-e2e shows a puppeteer timeout at the final step, and security-scan is logging repeated "handshake timeout" to scanner.redwood.internal. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T17:18:02Z] ERROR puppeteer: Navigation timeout of 30000 ms exceeded
[2026-03-20T17:18:10Z] WARN scanner-client: handshake timeout to scanner.redwood.internal:443 after 10s
```

miguel: we had a brief egress rule rollout earlier, could be correlated. @oncall-ops any infra changes?
oncall-ops: confirmed — small egress change at ~17:12 UTC, rollback at ~17:16 UTC after alerts. We're re-evaluating and will redeploy rollback if needed. :wrench:
kelsey: if this is transient we should try rerunning the failed jobs. Sam, can you trigger reruns for smoke-e2e and the security scan? Quick re-run: `cictl rerun job 1234 && cictl rerun job 1235`
sam: reruns queued. smoke-e2e -> job 1240, security-scan -> job 1241. Watching logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1240,https://ci.internal/runs/1241
deploybot: CI Gate update: still BLOCKED. security-scan job 1241 in PENDING >5m; recent runner logs show repeated handshake timeouts to scanner.redwood.internal. If this persists, recommend pinning release to v2.14.0 to avoid slipping the release window. /cc @joanna @kelsey :thinking_face:
joanna: prefer not to pin unless necessary. Release window ends in ~40m. If reruns don't pass in 10m, approve a pin as contingency. Sam, status updates every 5m pls.
sam: understood — will post updates. Added short-term alert on scanner connectivity and pinging infra.
